summary: The prepared main checkout still aligned eager hybrid target-verify token counts only to attention TP size. The focused regression reproduced 228 -> 232 rows for B=38,D=6,A=8 and 198 -> 200 for B=33. The candidate aligns fixed-width hybrid verify batches to lcm(attention TP size, tokens per request), and makes convolution/recurrent dummy rows state-free and initialized. Focused layout tests and gfx950 kernel tests pass after the change.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before execution against the prepared checkout: 5 failures, 2 passes and 5 passing subtests. Observed B=38 padding 228 -> 232 instead of 240, B=33 padding 198 -> 200 instead of 216, plus incorrect DP active/idle group boundaries.
Passing-after fixed-width alignment, output trimming, non-hybrid control, ragged-layout control, and DP MAX_LEN/SUM_LEN active/idle boundaries: 5 passed and 7 subtests passed.

On one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, 17 numerical kernel cases verified real-row equality to an independently executed unpadded reference, zero initialization of dummy output rows, and unchanged persistent/intermediate state for dummy requests across convolution, recurrent GDN and fused KDA paths.

remaining_limitations: The reported Qwen3.5-35B-A3B weights and 8x NVIDIA H20 TP8/EP8 environment were unavailable, so the full HTTP/model workload was not reproduced.

The single-gfx950 fixture validates the shared padding contract and affected GPU kernels, not multi-rank collective execution, model semantic accuracy, CUDA behavior, or the separate GLM DSA KPool request-plan issue tracked by upstream #37588.
No native C++ source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
